units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:1:9">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="N00631"><he>נִיוּוּל</he></cite>. Ib. III, end, 43ᶜ <he>נִיבּוּלָהּ רע</he> (an idol worshipped by an Israelite) is bad even when disfigured, i.e. its material can never be used even after its worshipper has abandoned and disfigured it.
Gen. R. s. 87; Cant. R. beg., v. זְבוּל.—נ׳ פה lascivious talk, v. נָבַל.
